query: Our dashboard page is really slow, Lighthouse gives it 38 on mobile. Can you speed it up?
expected_behavior: Measures a baseline first (LCP, INP, CLS, bundle size, API timings) before changing code
Reads reference/web-performance.md and targets the largest bottleneck (e.g. render-blocking JS, unoptimized LCP image, N+1 API queries)
Re-measures after each change and reports a before/after table against LCP < 2.5 s, INP < 200 ms, CLS < 0.1
Adds a regression guard such as a bundle-size budget or performance check in CI

query: We need to rename the column customer_name to full_name on our 50M-row orders table without downtime.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/reliability-observability.md and uses the expand/contract pattern across multiple deploys
Backfills in batches with lock_timeout set, avoiding a single blocking rename
Keeps the app compatible with both schema versions so rollback stays possible

query: Our app calls a third-party shipping-rates API that sometimes hangs for 30 seconds and takes our checkout down. Fix this.
expected_behavior: Adds an explicit timeout (a few seconds) and bounded retries with exponential backoff and jitter only for idempotent calls
Adds a circuit breaker and a graceful fallback (cached or default rates) instead of failing checkout
Adds metrics, structured logs with trace IDs, and an alert on dependency error rate or SLO burn
